title: Trainer table (0719) was reorganised by the hack. The trainer classes in the v4…
en: Trainer table (0719) was reorganised by the hack. The trainer classes in the v4 trdata (a/0/5/5) match the US ones for only 99 of 738 ids, so the US names seeded by position were almost all wrong and have been replaced. Rules used: official English for anime/Origins/Adventures/game characters; English given names in vanilla-localisation style for generic trainers (one English name per Chinese name, so rematches stay consistent); romanised Japanese surnames for Rocket grunts/evil scientists with surname names (Okamoto, Tanaka, …); pinyin for Sprout Tower monks and elders (like vanilla Sage Li/Chow); glossary species names for "Pokémon trainers". Names kept ≤8 chars (≤10 for a few Pokémon/group names; US max is 10).

en: Page layout: write short paragraphs (one to two lines, about 70 characters) separated by blank lines, so `wrap` never leaves a one-word orphan page. When the paragraph count happens to equal the zh break count, wrap copies the zh `{CLEAR}`s; a paragraph after a `{CLEAR}` then has only one line before a `{SCROLL}`. Change the paragraph count if that splits a sentence badly.

title: Team Rocket motto, house wording (B038/B039; reuse exactly, never the dub motto…
en: Team Rocket motto, house wording (B038/B039; reuse exactly, never the dub motto). Alternate speakers as the zh does: - 既然你诚心诚意地发问了 → Jessie: Since you ask so sincerely... - 我们就大发慈悲地告诉你 → James: ...we’ll be gracious enough to answer! - 为了防止世界被破坏 → Jessie: To keep the world from being wrecked! - 为了守护世界的和平 → James: To keep its peace forever protected! - 贯彻爱与真实的邪恶 → Jessie: Wicked for love and truth, through and through! - 可爱又迷人的反派角色 → James: Villains so charming, so lovable too! - 武藏！/ 我是武藏！ → Jessie: Jessie! / Jessie: I’m Jessie! (same for James) - 我们是穿梭在银河的火箭队 → Jessie: We’re Team Rocket, racing across the galaxy! - 白洞,白色的明天在等着我们 → James: A white hole! A bright white future awaits! - 就是这样喵 → Meowth: You heard it, meow! - Parodies reuse it (0459 #21/22: 既然你诚心诚意的找揍 → “...since you ask so sincerely for a beating...” / “...we’ll be gracious enough to grant your wish!”). Where the zh gives no speaker label (0321 #50–55), none is added.
origin_section: Decisions
origin_text:
**Team Rocket motto, house wording (B038/B039; reuse exactly, never the dub motto).** Alternate speakers as the zh does:
  - 既然你诚心诚意地发问了 → Jessie: Since you ask so sincerely...
  - 我们就大发慈悲地告诉你 → James: ...we’ll be gracious enough to answer!
  - 为了防止世界被破坏 → Jessie: To keep the world from being wrecked!
  - 为了守护世界的和平 → James: To keep its peace forever protected!
  - 贯彻爱与真实的邪恶 → Jessie: Wicked for love and truth, through and through!
  - 可爱又迷人的反派角色 → James: Villains so charming, so lovable too!
  - 武藏！/ 我是武藏！ → Jessie: Jessie! / Jessie: I’m Jessie! (same for James)
  - 我们是穿梭在银河的火箭队 → Jessie: We’re Team Rocket, racing across the galaxy!
  - 白洞,白色的明天在等着我们 → James: A white hole! A bright white future awaits!
  - 就是这样喵 → Meowth: You heard it, meow!
  - Parodies reuse it (0459 #21/22: 既然你诚心诚意的找揍 → “...since you ask so sincerely for a beating...” / “...we’ll be gracious enough to grant your wish!”). Where the zh gives no speaker label (0321 #50–55), none is added.

title: Walking-Pokémon reactions (0258) review rule

title: English naming keyboard: ABC page first, pinyin IME removed
en: Naming keyboard (fix naming-keyboard): tab 1 / page 0, the page the screen opens on, is ABC = the hack's ABC layout (A-M, N-Z, a-m, n-z, 0-9 . ,) in Western letter codes 0x0121-0x015E; tab 2 abc and tab 4 1/♪ are the hack's pages unchanged; tab 3 / page 2 (was the full-width ＡＢＣ page) is QWE = uppercase QWERTY with digits and ' - , . ; the pinyin IME is disabled for every page (0x02083C24 bne->b). Tab art: tab 1 shows the hack's ABC label, tab 3 'QWE' (naming_labels_en.png).
rationale: Localisation necessity (D-1002): the pinyin page composes hanzi, useless in English. The hack's full-width ＡＢＣ page stores codes 0x00AC-0x00DF whose glyphs are 9-11 px wide in the message fonts 1/2/4 (Western 6-7 px), so English names typed on it look spaced out. Putting ABC on page 0 makes it the default without touching the init code (only data rows + one branch).
alternatives: Change the default page to 2 (the hack's ABC tab): needs 5+ init patches (pageNum
fill colour 0x0D0D has no literal nearby
tab highlight) and keeps full-width letters

title: No nickname prompt after a catch is the hack's own behaviour (unchanged)
en: The untouched Chinese hack never asks for a nickname after a catch; our build does the same and is left unchanged. Evidence: the hack's battle overlay (ov14, 0x022007E0) has no reference to the naming-screen template gOverlayTemplate_NamingScreen (0x02101474; US ov12 references its 0x02102610 at 0x0224706C) and never loads battle message 0195#868 'Give a nickname to the caught X?' (0x364; US ov12 0x02246CD2), while every other naming caller (script, egg hatch, box name ov16, Oak ov49, ov44, ov77) keeps its reference. The hack's rewritten post-catch sequence (ov14 0x0222FCDC, states 0-8) goes: battle_string 2#57 'X's data was added to the Pokédex!' -> Pokédex page -> 2#480 'X joined the party!' / 2#481 'X was sent to the PC box!'. hg-engine has no skip-nickname option; the rewrite is the hack author's. Our build's ov14 is byte-identical to the Chinese ROM. Nicknames remain available via the Name Rater (script nickname, 10 chars).
rationale: User principle D-1002: reference is the untouched Chinese hack. Re-enabling would need new battle-overlay code (yes/no prompt + naming-screen overlay + graphics teardown/restore) in a rewritten state machine: medium-large, high risk.

title: Pokégear phone call conventions
en: Phone banks (0631–0700): (1) Gym Leader call banks share one layout: #0 contact name (digest name), #1 bad connection, #2 greeting/how-are-you (ends {SCROLL}), #3 advice, #4 free-time slot, #5 rematch invite ending with {VAR:0200:0} (Yes/No; keep it last), #6 accepted, #7 declined, #8 'you have other appointments', #9 meeting reminder, #10 self-introduction, #11 'did you forget our promise', #12–14 chat. (2) The hack moved every rematch from the US 'Fighting Dojo in Saffron City' to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → always 'the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier' (D-0357); never keep the Dojo from US lines. (3) Voices follow the digest (Koga formal no contractions, Erika/Falkner/Sabrina/Pryce formal, Jasmine stammering, Blaine 'Whoa-ho!', Chuck shouting, Blue cocky, Whitney 'Um' and bubbly); US phone lines that put another character's tone in a caller's mouth are rewritten. (4) The hack swaps some callers (0636 is Koga, not US Janine): check the zh name at #0/#10 before accepting US lines. (5) Generic Trainer greeting templates (0631: {VAR:0103:1} = caller, {VAR:0103:0} = player) keep the US wording; morning/day/evening pairs stay parallel. (6) US lines survive only where the zh says the same thing; 16-Gym and Champion-era references in the zh are kept.
rationale: Keep every caller consistent across R045–R048 phone banks

title: Trainer names over 7 characters break in battle (bank 0719)
en: OUR BUILD: 58 trainer names in 0719 are 8-10 characters (Giovanni x8, Lawrence, Lt. Surge, Prof. Oak, Weepinbell, Kangaskhan, Granny Mae...). The battle loader (hack arm9 0x02072544, pret EnemyTrainerSet_Init) copies the name with CopyStringToU16Array(str, trainer.name, 8); if it doesn't fit, the copy is skipped (GF_AssertFail 0x02025B2C only resets in link mode) and the name stays uninitialised stack data -> garbage/blank name in battle. US avoids this by storing every 0729 name {COMPRESSED} (9-bit packing: up to 10 characters fit in 7 units). Proposed fix: have build.py (or the bank) store all 0719 strings compressed, like US; the hack keeps String_Cat_HandleTrainerName (0x0202703C, called from the message formatter 0x0200C782), so compressed names expand. Keep names at 10 characters max. Then check a Giovanni/Lt. Surge battle in melonDS.
rationale: Integrity audit Phase A step 2: fixed-size buffer overflow introduced by the translation
answer: Fixed in the build: ws.export writes every 0719 name {COMPRESSED} (ids 707-711 plain, like US), build verify checks all 1024 fit u16[8] and decompress to the English; QA rule D-1330. DeSmuME on a test ROM (Oak's-lab aide patched to TrainerBattle): the old rc1 shows 'Rocket Boss <garbage>', the new build shows 'Rocket Boss Giovanni wants to battle!' / 'Giovanni sent out Arceus!', 'Leader Lt. Surge' and 'Kangaskhan wants to battle!'. Defeat line not yet seen (checklist).

title: Trainer names (0719) stored {COMPRESSED}, like US 0729

title: QA: fixed-buffer name banks 0719 and 0026
en: qa.py: bank 0719 is category trainer_names (max 10 characters, one line); check_name_buffer errors if a name has a tag, a code >= 0x1FF (not_compressible) or doesn't fit u16[8] once packed (name_buffer); raw ids 707-711 max 7 characters. Bank 0026 (Battle Frontier trainer names, copied plain into u16[8] at hack arm9 0x0204AD38) is category frontier_names, max 7 characters.
rationale: Keeps every trainer name compressible and every Frontier name inside its buffer (D-1326); both limits match US.

title: Sheet lists shop/field sources the ROM lacks
en: UNOBTAINABLE/SHOPS (author's Items sheet 3.2道具 vs ROM): no fixed source exists in the ROM (item balls, hidden items, script gifts, shop lists) for Qualot Berry and Tamato Berry (sheet rows 173/176: 'Saffron shop'), Salac, Petaya, Apicot and Lansat Berry (rows 205-208: 'Celadon Dept. Store 5F') and Grip Claw (row 288: 'item ball, Goldenrod Dept. Store B1F'). Only random sources we do not read (phone-contact gift berries, Pokéwalker, lottery) could still give them. The shops differ from the sheet too: Celadon 5F (map 374) sells vitamins, X items and incenses/seeds (lists 22, 23, 42), not the pinch berries; Liechi/Ganlon are only sold on the S.S. Anne (map 307, ₽800); Saffron's shop sells no EV-lowering berries; Azalea's shop (list 45) has no Lemonade or TinyMushroom (rows 34, 88); the Union Cave B1F weekday vendor sells Focus Sash for ₽100 where the sheet has Magnet on Saturday (row 244); Quick Ball is not in the standard clerks' list (row 17). Items the sheet rates S ('no source designed') are sold in the ROM: Full Restore, X Attack/Defense/Speed/Accuracy/Sp. Atk/Sp. Def, Guard Spec., Dire Hit (Celadon 5F and Saffron lists 5/22; some also hidden). Oran Berry: sheet ₽50, ROM vendors ₽100 (New Bark) / ₽80 (Goldenrod), Viridian shop ₽20 (item table). v3 CHECK (agent:verifyB2, work/notes/sheet_mismatch_verification.md §4.6): for the berry rows and Quick Ball the sheet is the v3 state and v4 removed the source (sheet outdated). In v3, Saffron's list 5 sold the six EV-lowering berries (Pomeg to Tamato), Celadon 5F list 22 sold Liechi, Ganlon, Salac, Petaya, Apicot, Lansat, Micle and Custap, and the standard clerks' list 3 had Quick Ball. v4 turned lists 5 and 22 into X-item lists and sends the standard clerks' SpecialMartBuy(3) to a fixed list at arm9 0x020F8B3E (balls, potions, heals, repels, Escape Rope; no Quick Ball). A ₽1000 berry vendor is still in Saffron's script file 825, but no script reaches it (v3 or v4). Grip Claw, Lemonade, TinyMushroom, Magnet and the Oran price have no v3 source or match either: sheet errors. The S-rated items already had sources in v3 (Full Restore item balls and hidden; X items hidden). See work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md §3.
rationale: Phase B2 row-by-row cross-check of the author spreadsheets against the ROM data (work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md).

title: Saffron Dojo teaches Charge instead of Volt Switch
en: GAMEPLAY BUG (suspected, verify in game): the Saffron Fighting Dojo tutor (script file 829; bank 0525 #61-#72, '松活弹抖闪电鞭' = Volt Switch, ₽10000) runs CountMonMoves and, when the chosen Pokémon has 3 or fewer moves (GoToIf LE 3 at pc 4321 -> 6363), calls SetMonMove(slot = move count, move 268) = Charge, the old v3 slot of Volt Switch, then shows 'learned Volt Switch' (#69) and takes ₽10000. Only the four-move path (pc 4437) sets move 521 Volt Switch; the retry path at pc 6641-6748 also uses 268. Same kind of v3-id leftover as the Blackthorn Play Rough/Flail tutor (D-1305). The author's sheet (3.2道具 row 554) lists Volt Switch here.
rationale: Phase B2 row-by-row cross-check of the author spreadsheets against the ROM data (work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md). Observed in the emulator 2026-10-06 (CN ROM and EN build of Oct 5, `emu_harness.py hackbugs --case tutor`): run from L3446 with the lead chosen: with 3 moves L4309 -> L6363 wrote move 268 (充电, Charge) and $10,000 was taken; with 4 moves @4437 wrote 521 (Volt Switch), $10,000 taken. Confirmed.

title: Species stats/types differ from author's sheet
en: DATA: the author's 4.0精灵数据 sheet matches the ROM personal data in 4,872 of 4,926 base stats, 813 of 821 type pairs and all but 6 ability slots. ROM differs from the sheet: types of Alolan Sandshrew (ROM Ice/Steel, sheet Ice), Rapidash (Fire/Fairy vs Fire), Glalie (Ice vs Ice/Dark), Staraptor (Fighting/Flying vs Normal/Flying), Hippowdon (Ground/Rock vs Ground), Servine and Serperior (Grass/Dragon vs Grass), Braviary (Normal/Flying vs Fighting/Flying); stats of Alolan Sandslash, Golduck, Ponyta, Rapidash, Seel, Galarian Articuno, Phanpy, Ludicolo, Slakoth, Medicham, Normal Deoxys, Staravia, Shieldon, Bonsly, Mime Jr., Glaceon, Dialga, Palkia, Conkeldurr, Sawsbuck, Diggersby, Helioptile, Sylveon, Bewear, Hakamo-o, Blastoise and Tentacool (full table in work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md §1). Pure column swaps (sheet slips): Tentacool Atk/Def, Ponyta HP/SpA, Helioptile, Hakamo-o. v3 CHECK (agent:verifyB2, work/notes/sheet_mismatch_verification.md §4.1-4.2): the sheet has the v3 value, so v4 changed it later (sheet outdated), for Normal Deoxys (v3 50/150/50/150/50/150; the v4 base record now carries the Attack Forme stats 180/20/180/20), Dialga (v3 Atk 120/SpD 100, v4 swapped them), Slakoth HP (v3 60), the types of Staraptor (v3 Normal/Flying), Hippowdon (v3 Ground) and Rapidash (v3 Fire; its stats match neither), Krabby Lv26 and Mantyke Lv30. Sheet errors (ROM = v3 and/or the official value): Blastoise (sheet 73/90, ROM 78/85, v3 83/85, not a swap), Galarian Articuno (the row carries the official Kanto stats; the Kanto row equals the ROM), Golduck, Seel, Phanpy, Ludicolo, Shieldon, Conkeldurr, Sawsbuck, Diggersby, Bewear, Alolan Sandshrew/Sandslash; evolutions of Ivysaur, Exeggcute, Misdreavus, Piplup, Prinplup, Zorua, Sandygast. The rest differ from v3 and v4 alike. Evolution: 17 levels/methods differ (e.g. Ivysaur ROM Lv32 vs sheet 36, Piplup 16 vs 20, Prinplup 36 vs 45, Zorua 30 vs 48, Mareanie 30 vs 38, Sandygast 42 vs 32, Krabby 28 vs 26; Boldore/Gurdurr trade vs Lv35/40; Kleavor has no evolution in the ROM, sheet Lv35).
rationale: Phase B2 row-by-row cross-check of the author spreadsheets against the ROM data (work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md).
answer: User OK on the decision page 2026-10-06 (SUMMARY card, no vetoes). Informational: Informational (see work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md §1).

title: Move data differ from author's move sheets
en: DATA: 4.0招式变动 (56 moves) and 4.0新增技能机 (TM93-TM130) match the live move table in 505 of 508 type/category/power/accuracy/PP fields; all 38 new TM numbers and their shops match. Differences: Skull Bash power ROM 120 vs sheet 100; Cross Chop accuracy ROM 100 vs 90; Meteor Beam (TM125) accuracy ROM 90 vs 95. Effects: the sheet gives Dragon Claw a high critical-hit ratio, the data has crit stage 0 (the ROM description agrees with the data); Rock Wrecker is 'both foes' in the sheet but single-target in the data; the sheet calls Bounce one-turn and the data agrees (agent:verifyB2): its charge flag (flag bit 1) is clear, as on Skull Bash, Razor Wind and Sky Attack, which v4 made one-turn. Only the description 0738#340 (two-turn) is stale. The effect id is still the vanilla two-turn 263, so an in-game test remains useful. v3 values (Skull Bash 130, Cross Chop 80, Dragon Claw no crit, Rock Wrecker single target) do not match the sheet either. Sharpness (锋锐) moves: all 23 moves in 特性适用范围 carry the slicing flag (move flag bit 34). Mega Launcher's list could not be located in the data.
rationale: Phase B2 row-by-row cross-check of the author spreadsheets against the ROM data (work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md).
answer: The open in-game part (Bounce) observed in the emulator (emu_harness.py vqueue --case probe, CN ROM and EN build CRC32 576E1E55; sheets work/build/harness/verifyqueue/<cn|en>/probe_bounce_pages.png, probe_fly_pages.png): a Mewtwo's Bounce against a wild Shuckle printed 'used Bounce!' and no 'sprang up' (1#734) and no miss message, the foe acted in the same turn and the command menu came back every turn; the Fly control printed 'flew up high' (1#714) and struck on the next turn. Bounce is one-turn as the sheet and the data say; only the description 0738#340 (two turns) is stale and stays as the Chinese has it. The data differences listed above stay as recorded (hack data, D-1002). Listed for players in guide known-issues (move behaviour).

title: Signposts with a map/route graphic use the 160 px sign box
en: The 62 messages shown by DirectionSignpost type 0/1 (map or route graphic; pret dialog_box.c: x+7 tiles, 20x4 tiles = 160 px, 2 lines) carry the per-string field "category": "sign" and are wrapped to 160 px. Type 2 (1 use) and SetSignpostMap types 2/3 + TrainerTips (173 uses) use the full 27-tile box and stay at 216 px. Found by disassembling a/0/1/2 (romdata.disasm); msg bank = the map header's msg_bank of the zone whose scripts_bank is that file (one bank per file). Overflow on a sign page continues with {CLEAR}; rewrap before rewording.
rationale: QA checked signposts at 216 px; four English lines overflowed the 160 px box.

en: The Pewter City town sign (script file 748, script 4, bg event; DirectionSignpost msg 20, type 0) prints 0453#20 '想学的话随时欢迎再来。' ('If you want to learn it, come back anytime.'), which is the Metal Claw tutor's line (NPCMsg 20 in script 31). title: New QA lints: prefix_split, mid_sentence_page, glossary_name, zh_variant, register validate
en: qa.py check adds: prefix_split (error: a line ends with Mt./Prof./S.S./Lt./Mr./Mrs./Ms./Dr., Lv./No. before a number, or Pokémon before Center/League; TMs./HMs. are not prefixes); mid_sentence_page (warning: a {SCROLL} page ends mid-sentence where the zh page at the same position ends a sentence; with a different page count only mid-clause endings are reported when no zh page breaks mid-sentence); glossary_name (capitalised name spans in prose vs the glossary, name banks 0232/0739/0219/0711 incl. 'abbreviated from' notes, 0724/0033/0183 and active register terms: old Gen 4 names, spelling variants, name-bank abbreviations in prose, one-edit misspellings; error for species/moves, warning otherwise; bare Nidoran is resolved from the zh 尼多兰/尼多朗; reviewed false positives in qa_config glossary_names.allow). qa.py variants reports zh_variant groups (identical zh, layout ignored, same category, different English; context/branch notes and The wild/The foe’s battle owner variants skipped). decisions.py validate checks refs (text refs must name an existing bank and ids; zero-padded ids are flagged as PROGRESS bank-pair artefacts) and superseded_by/related/conflicts_with/decision_id links.
rationale: External review (RV-012, RV-018, RV-019, RB-D01..D11, lint 3/6/7 in external_review_consolidation.md): these check classes found real issues that QA never enforced.

title: Double-size text: one line per page
en: Text inside {VAR:FF01:200}…{VAR:FF01:100} stays on one line per page, like the Chinese: no {NEWLINE} or {CLEAR} inside the span. 200 % text is twice as tall but not wider, so the line may use the full 216 px box width. A shout that does not fit is split into pages: {VAR:FF01:200}…{VAR:FF01:100}{SCROLL}{VAR:FF01:200}…{VAR:FF01:100}, at a sentence or phrase boundary.
rationale: A 200 % line fills the 32 px message box; a second line is drawn below the window's pixel buffer and corrupts the heap (rc3 crash at the Route 3 Misty scene; work/notes/heap_audit.md). QA counts 200 % lines as two lines (too_many_lines).
alternatives: Remove the size tags (a tester's NoBigText patch): avoids the crash but drops the hack's emphasis.

title: Text banks are always read line by line (code patch msgload-all)
en: NewMsgDataFromNarc (arm9 0x0200BA98) always creates an on-demand message handle (type 1): 'adds r5, r0, #0' -> 'movs r5, #1' at 0x0200BA9A. No screen loads a whole text bank into its heap.
rationale: The English banks are up to 3x the Chinese ones; screens that loaded whole banks ran out of memory (rc3: summary skills page crash, bag 108 bytes from failing). Localisation necessity under D-1002; checked with work/tools/memcheck.py.
alternatives: Enlarge each screen's heap (depends on the parent heap in every context
Patch only the five measured call sites (kept as a second layer)

title: Canon English for anime/manga quotes
en: Where the hack's Chinese quotes the Chinese dub of the Pokémon anime or the Chinese edition of the manga (catchphrases, mottos, attack calls, famous lines), use the official English dub/manga wording instead of our own. The hack is built on canon events, and canon English keeps that link. Use only canon wording you can verify; if unsure, translate the Chinese and add a question. Hack-original lines and the hack's own variations stay translated from the Chinese. Real-world song lyrics are still never quoted (D-0368). Tone stays faithful at full strength (D-0627).
rationale: User decision 2026-10-04: adopt canon English wording instead of invented house wording; supersedes the no-dub-motto rule.

title: Team Rocket motto, canon English dub wording
en: Jessie & James's motto uses the English dub wording from the original series (Bulbapedia 'Team Rocket motto'). Speakers alternate as the zh does; no label where the zh has none. 既然你诚心诚意地发问了 → Prepare for trouble! / 我们就大发慈悲地告诉你 → Make it double! / 为了防止世界被破坏 → To protect the world from devastation! / 为了守护世界的和平 → To unite all peoples within our nation! / 贯彻爱与真实的邪恶 → To denounce the evils of truth and love! / 可爱又迷人的反派角色 → To extend our reach to the stars above! / 武藏！, 我是武藏！ → Jessie! (same for James) / 我们是穿梭在银河的火箭队 → Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light! / 白洞,白色的明天在等着我们 → Surrender now, or prepare to fight! / 就是这样喵 → Meowth! That's right! Cassidy & Butch (0399): Prepare for trouble... / ...and make it double! / Here's our mission, so you better listen! / To infect the world with devastation! / To blight all people in every nation! / To denounce the goodness of truth and love! / To extend our wrath to the stars above! / Cassidy! / And Butch, of course! / We're Team Rocket, circling Earth all day and night! / Surrender to us now or you will surely lose the fight! Quotes of 白色的明天 outside the motto (0369#93/#174, 0718#174) stay literal ('a bright white future').
rationale: User decision D-1436: canon English wording replaces the D-0035 house wording.

en: Crystal Onix is Onix form 1, stored as species/personal index 1439 (form table: 95/1 → 1439; Rock/Ice). title: Stats hint says L/R, but only L opens IV/EV panel in normal button mode
en: The Chinese hint says L/R displays IVs and EVs. In the untouched v4.0.3 ROM with normal button mode, L opens the combined IV/EV panel on the stats page and L or B closes it; R did nothing with the panel closed or open. ARM9 0x02087CD4 checks L (0x0200) and page 1. Recheck other button modes before calling R universally unsupported. Keep the translation faithful; document tested controls separately. Evidence: work/notes/in_game_shortcuts.md and ignored work/build/shortcut-audit/panel-*.png.
rationale: Original-ROM runtime checks and the input handler disagree with the general L/R wording; no gameplay or translation changes made.
answer: Observed in the emulator (emu_harness.py vqueue --case buttons, CN ROM and EN build CRC32 576E1E55; screenshots buttons_options.png, buttons_m*_{R,L}.png): the hack's Options screen has no BUTTON MODE row (MUSIC SPEED, BATTLE SCENE, BATTLE STYLE, TITLE SCREEN, BATTLE BG, FRAME); changing each row flips bits 0, 6 and 9 of the options word, so BATTLE BG uses bit 9, the vanilla button-mode field. With bits 8-9 forced to 0, 1 and 2, on the stats page R never changed the screen and L opened the IV/EV panel every time. R never opens the panel; the Chinese hint's 'L/R' is the hack's text and stays faithful. (Side finding: the English panel's 'Sp. Atk' label covers the first IV digit, D-1574.)

en: File 29 script 3 (radio quiz): each question menu is cancellable (MenuInit 4th byte 1, B result 0xFFFE) but only the three wrong options are tested; 0xFFFE falls through as correct, so pressing B on all five questions passes the quiz. In your favour; not confirmed in game.
rationale: Radio Tower script audit: menu cancel value not handled in the hack's rewritten quiz

title: Daytime Lycanroc form is uninitialised
en: CODE: Rockruff's evolution sets Dusk (17:00-19:59) or Midnight (20:00-03:59) form; outside those hours the form is read from a stack byte that is never written (0x02074AE4, sp+0xC), so a daytime Lycanroc isn't guaranteed to be Midday Form. In the emulator every daytime evolution (Rare Candy and after a battle, 15 runs) gave Midday Form: latent.
rationale: Disassembly of evolution completion. Emulator 2026-10-05 (worktree-agent-a4b139276ed03996d): Rare Candy evolutions gave Midday (form 0) at 06:00/12:00/15:00 in 9 of 9 runs, Dusk at 18:00, Midnight at 22:00 and 02:00. The uninitialised byte is real in code but was 0 on the Rare Candy path. Emulator 2026-10-06 (emu_harness.py open --case rockruff, both ROMs, agent:item6): Rockruff Lv24 one exp point short of Lv25 won a scripted wild battle (Rattata, Pidgey or Sentret) and evolved after the battle: the form byte written at 0x02074B0E was 0 and Lycanroc Midday Form was stored in 6 of 6 daytime runs per ROM (12:00 x3, 15:00 x3); controls 18:00 -> 2 (Dusk), 22:00 -> 1 (Midnight). The after-battle path also leaves the byte 0 in every run seen.
answer: User OK on the decision page 2026-10-06 (SUMMARY card, no vetoes). Documented hack finding, not fixed (D-1337): latent, no visible effect; noted on the site Lycanroc species page; no known-issues entry.

title: Obvious hack text errors may be fixed, with explicit user approval per case
en: Amends D-1195. Default stays: translate what the Chinese says and log suspected hack bugs as hack-finding questions. Where the text is obviously wrong and the right English is unambiguous (e.g. game data proves which Pokémon, trainer or place is meant), the English may be corrected, but only after the user explicitly approves that specific case. Agents never fix on their own: they log the finding with the evidence and a proposed fix. Approved fixes note the finding id in the string's notes and resolve the finding. Gameplay/logic bugs stay unfixed (D-1337).
rationale: User decision 2026-10-05, after the Route 8 Skitty/Glameow report.

title: Trainer HP IV override repeats one stat
en: The original Chinese trainer loader selects IV 10 at levels up to 40, 20 at levels 41-79, or 31 at levels 80+, then writes MON_DATA field 70 (HP IV) six times without incrementing the field ID. HP alone receives that value; the other five IVs retain floor(stored difficulty byte * 31 / 255). Suspected loop bug; preserve gameplay and document the actual HP/other IVs. Evidence: work/notes/trainer_runtime_review.md.
rationale: Verified the original loader, field-70 setter and stat calculation; guide parser previously claimed uniform IVs. Observed in the emulator 2026-10-06 (CN ROM and EN build of Oct 5, `emu_harness.py hackbugs --case trainer`): foe parties read from RAM in battle for trainers 11, 31, 80, 253, 865, 146, 376: HP IV 10 at Lv <= 40, 20 at 41-79, 31 at >= 80, the other five IVs iv*31//255 (trainer 11: Lv32 -> 10/12x5, Lv42 -> 20/1x5; trainer 31: Lv80 -> 31/30x5, Lv1 -> 10/6x5). Confirmed.
answer: User OK on the decision page 2026-10-06 (SUMMARY card, no vetoes). Documented hack finding, not fixed (D-1337): documented on the site trainer pages (not player-actionable); no known-issues entry.

title: Hack text fixes never delete or invent text
en: Amends D-1496. An approved fix only replaces the wrong part of a line. It never deletes text the Chinese has and never adds content that isn't in it. The replacement wording comes from the Chinese itself, the Japanese/US original the hack translated, or official text for the right Pokémon, move or item. If a correct line would need a deletion or invented content, keep the line as it is and leave the finding open.
rationale: User decision 2026-10-05 during the hack-findings review (D-1037c: the Curse-era Ghost-type sentence in the Poltergeist tutor line stays).

title: Arceus Plates land on the wrong form
en: CODE: the Plate routine (arm9 0x02070D98) writes the Gen 4 type number as Arceus's stored form (Flame 10, Splash 11, Zap 13, Meadow 12, Icicle 15, Mind 14, Draco 16, Dread 17), while the hack's form table uses the newer order with Fairy at 9, so those forms point at personal entries of another type (form 10 = the Water entry). In the emulator the summary, the battle INFO panel, type effectiveness against Arceus and Judgment's type all follow the Plate (5 Plates tested in battle, all 16 on the summary), so no visible effect was found.
rationale: Disassembly of 0x02070D98 jump table and the form table; independent review agrees. Emulator 2026-10-06 (emu_harness.py open --case arceus, both ROMs, agent:item6): Arceus Lv100 given the Flame, Splash, Zap, Dread or Fist Plate through Bag -> Give (stored forms 10, 11, 13, 17, 1) fought a scripted wild Pokemon knowing one probe move. The battle INFO panel shows the Plate's type (Fire, Water, Electric, Dark, Fighting); the probe was super effective as for the Plate type in all five (Water Gun on Flame, ThunderShock on Splash, Earthquake on Zap, Karate Chop on Dread, Gust on Fist; the personal-entry types Water/Grass/Psychic/Fairy would give not very effective or neutral), and Judgment was super effective as the Plate type (vs Tangela, Magmar, Psyduck, Drowzee, Rattata). So the stored-form mismatch has no in-battle effect either: no visible effect observed anywhere; it only matters if some code reads the type from the form's personal entry, none found.
answer: User OK on the decision page 2026-10-06 (SUMMARY card, no vetoes). Documented hack finding, not fixed (D-1337): latent, no visible effect; no known-issues entry.

title: Safari Zone wild double battle freezes
en: Safari Zone: the hack's wild-double roll (ov2 0x022470C4, rand%4==0 with 2+ usable Pokémon) runs before the Safari check, so ~1 in 4 Safari encounters builds a Double Battle (0x02050C34 flag 0x4A) while the Safari branch (0x0224718C -> 0x02248204) creates only one wild Pokémon. The second opponent is uninitialised junk (nameless, random level/status, invisible sprite) and the game freezes at the command menu. Observed on the untouched Chinese ROM from a player's save (Geodude Lv15 double during Baoba's test) and forced on the English build (overlay 2 byte-identical). Player report from DraStic (Lv79 PAR junk opponent, then crash). Per D-1337 not fixed; workaround: enter the Safari Zone with only one usable Pokémon in the party.

rationale: Emulator VRAM dump on the search page: window tiles 0x1D0-0x1FF equal #4 tiles 98/101; our pool had overwritten them with letter tiles (garbled bars, D-1505). Overlay sits at (56,24) over screen 0 (D-1514 black block).

title: Trainer card money sign and date order: proposal
en: Needs your choice (D-1513). The hack (Japanese base) prints MONEY, POKéDEX and the dates as bare numbers and bakes the units 元 只 年 月 日 into the card graphic (a/0/4/9 #41); the USA code prints them through format strings (US 0727 #19 '${VAR:0137:5,0}', #22 'Mon dd, 20yy') that bank 0717 does not have. Our approved composed card graphic blanks 元/只 and draws '/' for 年/月. Options: (a) code port: print money and dates through format strings like the USA trainer card (append the US-style strings to 0717 and rewrite the overlay's print calls) - gives '$3690' and 'Sep. 29, 2026' (or 9/29/26); real code work, moderate risk, separate task. (b) graphic: a '$' in font-0 lettering at a fixed spot left of the MONEY field ('$     3690', number stays right-aligned) - new composed lettering, needs your approval as an exception like D-1109. (c) keep as is (no unit, yy/mm/dd). Recommendation: (c) now, (a) later if wanted. The date gap ('26/ 09/ 29') comes from the 8-px 年/月 cells; centring the approved '/' in its cell would shorten the gap but keeps yy/mm/dd.
rationale: No string or halfword patch can add the sign or reorder the date; a graphic sign is a new design.

title: Goldenrod City crashes on entry when both NPC groups (flags 439 and 441) are visible
en: Every Goldenrod City object (zone 76, events 73; 49 objects, 34 sprites; US HeartGold has 21/6) is behind hide flag 439 (21 townsfolk, 18 sprites) or 441 (27 Team Rocket takeover NPCs, 15 sprites), plus 792/1366. The field's overworld sprite resource table holds 32 graphics (manager at field+0xF0, queue ov1 0x021F9660 -> arm9 0x02025E38). With 439 and 441 both clear, entering Goldenrod by any map change (door, Fly, warp) queues 33; the 33rd finds no free slot (0x02026104 returns NULL, the assert 0x02025B2C is a no-op), the code writes through NULL at 0x0-0x16 (IRQ vectors) and the game crashes. Observed on the Chinese ROM and the English build: flags clear -> crash; 439 only (18 sprites), 441 only (21) or both set -> fine. The hack's scripts normally swap the two flags as a pair, but some change only one: the first Hall of Fame (file 822 @2482, zone 306) clears 439 without touching 441; Radio Tower deck file 34 @1195 and Radio Tower 1F file 29 @3194/@3407 clear 441 without setting 439. Which real story order leaves both clear is not yet confirmed. Likely cause of a player report: game crashed (losing progress) after leaving the Goldenrod fortune house; the fortune teller's script does not touch these flags. Workaround for an affected save: none in game short of an external flag edit (set 439 or 441). Per D-1337 not fixed.
rationale: Emulator harness: allocator/NULL-write trace, sprite queue log, 8 flag-combination runs on both ROMs; script dumps of files 822, 34, 29, 31, 842, 92.

en: Solving the Ruins of Alph Ho-Oh panel clears flag 565 (file 45 L174–L182), set at new game (149 @190) and otherwise cleared only in the Molly dream world after Silver's battle (file 50 L3224). The chamber has no story gate. On arrival in the dream world the map-load code (file 50 L2686 → L3305 → End) then skips the arrival gathering: Silver and Croconaw already stand by the steps, Gold and Crystal aren't gathered, and Silver's battle is skipped. title: Forest of Time plays empty or early scenes during the bug hunt

Var 0x4099 is 2 from Bugsy's Honey hand-over (file 92 L6516), 3/4/5 during the hunt (L10693, L10735, L2209), 2 again at the reward (L5713); only the ranger's Sammy scene (L5372, needs 0x40A2 = 17) sets 3 for real. title: Easy Chat ABC MODE shows a Japanese kana grid
en: The Easy Chat word picker (e.g. the Violet Pokémon Center TV interviewer, file 857 PromptEasyChat) opens in GROUP MODE, which is translated. title: Saffron move relearner crash not reproduced
en: Players report a black screen/crash after choosing a Pokémon at Mr. Psychic's move relearner in Saffron (player reports on Discord: rc5, 2026-10-06; Bradams' fork, 2026-10-03). Not reproduced in the emulator (DeSmuME): 53 runs on CN, rc4, rc5, Speedoption and the develop build, full flow (party pick, app, scroll, forget, Heart Scale, back to Saffron), worst cases: 6-Pokémon party with long nicknames, Lv. 100 Gallade/Lucario/Mr. Rime and hack species 1146 as lead, large leads, walk-in/map-warp entry, night/morning, straight after a battle/Bag/summary, mashing A. No NULL allocation, no write to 0–0x3F. Heap headroom rules out memory exhaustion: relearner app heap 66 (147,456 B) has 32,476 B spare at worst on all English ROMs (CN only 7,382 B, because the English builds load message banks on demand); forget screen heap 19 36,552 B spare (CN 14,576); root heap 3 never below 123 KB. Saffron needs 27 overworld sprites (limit 32), so not the D-1547 overflow. Bradams' Speedoption (rc4 text) has no relearner-specific change versus rc4 (script 830 and banks 0526/0736/0626 identical); its +32 KiB root heap doesn't touch the relevant margin (heap 66 is unchanged). Remaining suspects: emulator/hardware-specific behaviour or the reporter's save. Needs the reporter's save/savestate, the Pokémon chosen and the emulator/platform. Evidence: work/build/harness/bugreports-20261006/relearner/ and relearner-heap/summary.md.

title: Surfing to the Shipyard Ruins could lose the Protector
en: The Shipyard Ruins door biker (735 script 12) and the Chief (879 script 1) have no quest gate, and the south shore by the ruins door touches open water; a high-tide guard sits there only until the Route 39 scene (flag 2024, 249 @4066). After Route 39 a player who Surfs there may skip the guards and Big Sis. Winning the gauntlet before agreeing to the One Island asker's request sets 2022 (879 L2424) and hides him, so flag 2021 is never set: no Protector, and the entrance guards never open. Needs an emulator check of the Surf landing.

title: Vanilla Rock Tunnel B1F items are probably unobtainable
en: The items the site lists for 'Rock Tunnel B1F' (Iron, PP Up, Eviolite, Revive, Max Potion, HP Up) are on zone 452, the vanilla Rock Tunnel B1F; the hack's Rock Tunnel is zone 342, and no warp event or Warp command leads into zone 452. Their item flags reuse story flags 1224–1226, harmless only because the map is unreachable. Needs an independent recheck (availability rules) before removing them from the site.

title: Can the Lavender Town Blue battle be bypassed?
en: The Lavender Town Blue trigger (file 17 coord script 4, var 0x40B5 = 0; sets 1 at L3796) is what arms the Team Rocket HQ B3F east-room Crystal scene (file 91 coord script 1 needs 0x40B5 = 1). If the Lavender trigger can be walked around, the HQ scene never plays (the password is still obtainable). Not checked.

title: Can the Silver Conference be reached without the Mineral Badge?
en: Crystal stays in Olivine until the Mineral Badge; the Dream World only opens with the League HQ round-3 order after the Silver Conference. Gold's Badge race (file 937 L3317–L3450) only changes his lines and no script on the story path calls CheckBadge 13, so whether the story can reach the Silver Conference without the Mineral Badge (leaving Crystal in Olivine at round 3) is unverified.

title: Triple Axel power per kick

en: The illusion-grunt scene (file 17 L2493) sets flag 1155, which is also the hide flag of the Pokémon Tower Trainers (Medium Colette and the illusion Prof. Oak, Archie and Petrel; 'Mom' is always beaten first) and of Magcargo. Skipped Trainers are gone the next time a floor loads; none has an item. Looks intended (the illusions end). title: Text speed: frame-bounded batches
en: FAST stops a glyph batch when the measured cost of the next glyph plus the measured rest of the frame would not fit before VBlank (costs measured at run time; while fewer than 3 rests are measured the rest counts as at least 7 lines), so FAST never pushes the game loop past VBlank; every task still draws at least one glyph and the 3-glyph budget is a maximum. NORMAL uses the original printer and needs no frame rule.
rationale: Step 4 review measured field-dialogue frame drops (SLOW 36 / MEDIUM 37 / FAST 33 frames, game at 30 fps while FAST prints); user chose this fix on 2026-10-06.

title: Evolution moves at level 0 are skipped
en: Confirmed in untouched Chinese v4.0.3 and the local English WIP: Rare Candy evolution from Golbat Lv29 to Crobat Lv30 skips Cross Poison (440), Charmeleon Lv35 to Charizard Lv36 skips Air Slash (403), and Magikarp Lv19 to Gyarados Lv20 skips Bite (44), with three empty move slots. Their level-0 learnset entries are present and identical in both ROMs. Evolution calls 0x02070870, which selects only entries matching the current level and skips level 0. Positive control: delayed Charizard evolution at Lv39 learns Scary Face (184) in both ROMs while skipping Air Slash. Evidence and reproduction: work/notes/evolution_moves_investigation.md and work/build/evolution-moves-repro/. Preserve original behavior under D-1002/D-1337.
rationale: Eight isolated emulator runs and matching binary data establish an original-hack bug, not a translation regression; battle-triggered evolution and the reporter-specific build remain untested.

title: Field text keeps vanilla rate at 30 fps
en: When a game-loop pass of the hack spans two or more VBlanks (most outdoor maps run at 30 fps), the text printers in the 8 printer slots get one extra turn before the VBlank wait, if one glyph plus the measured rest of the frame fits; at most one extra turn per pass, only for printers whose next step draws a glyph. Field text then prints at vanilla FAST rate (1 glyph per frame instead of 1 per 2). Applies at every text-speed setting. Pauses counted in printer turns last vanilla length in those scenes. Other tasks in the print queue keep the hack's rate.
rationale: Measured 2026-10-07: hack/EN print ~2.0 frames per glyph in Viridian, Route 30, Cherrygrove, Violet vs vanilla US FAST 0.98; likely cause of player complaints about slow text. User approved research and implementation if safe.

NORMAL = the hack's original printer plus the 30 fps printer catch-up (D-1603), i.e. vanilla FAST rate everywhere; FAST = batched printer (up to 3 glyphs per task, measured frame rule D-1601) plus catch-up. en: The English patch supports real DS/DSi/3DS hardware by bypassing the hack's anti-piracy checks (overlay114, Nintendo DS Protect) inside the single English xdelta patch: code patches antipiracy-ov114-0x864 … 0xCCC in code_patches.json. title: Anti-piracy bypass vs fidelity (D-1002/D-1337)
en: The anti-piracy bypass makes each of the six overlay114 entry points return the value the untouched Chinese hack returns on a genuine cartridge or an emulator (0/1/0/1/0/1, measured in DeSmuME), so it changes no behaviour on emulators or genuine carts and does not conflict with D-1002 or D-1337. It is a platform-compatibility fix where our delivery differs from a genuine cart, not a hack-bug fix. Other hack bugs seen on hardware are still reported, not fixed; a hardware-only crash that the untouched Chinese hack also shows on an emulator is a hack bug.
rationale: Static and emulator analysis: stubs return the genuine-path values; genuine-path callbacks are bare bx lr; no integrity check covers the entry prologues. Independently re-verified 2026-10-07 (18 call sites, polarity in DeSmuME, MAC-zero simulation).

title: Full English fidelity review requires user translation decisions
en: Review all existing English against the original Chinese and author intent. Preserve meaning and strength, including threats, violence, insults and heavy or dark adult content; do not soften or add unsupported crudeness. Reviewers must be critical of existing solutions and ask the user about uncertain interpretations with concrete suggestions. Do not apply proposed translation decisions without the user.

title: Rocket HQ B1F renderer data abort on melonDS
en: Reproduced on melonDS 1.1 (macOS ARM64, interpreter, built-in BIOS): a player's save Origin_HeartGold_v4.0.3_EN_v1.0.0-rc5.sav loads at map 247 (13,4), then walking right freezes at (17,4) before the camera ambush. Untouched Chinese v4.0.3 and English WIP both enter ARM9 abort mode: CPSR 60000097, saved PC FFFF0108, abort LR 0202469E; instruction 02024696 is ldr r0,[r0]. DeSmuME 0.9.12 passes this position and reaches the double battle, while read-only hooks observe null reads at the same instruction. See work/notes/rocket_hq_freeze_repro_20261008.md. Original-hack failure, preserve under D-1337; malformed model/texture resource suspected, exact asset not yet identified.
rationale: Same supplied battery save and identical failure instruction in untouched Chinese and English; saved CPU state rules out dialogue wait or input-only failure.
answer: Fixed as an approved exception to D-1337 (user, 2026-10-08): fix overworld-texture-frame-bounds.

en: The speaker expresses their own lack of further response. Seeing Lugia again remains conditional on collecting everything first. Objects to collect remain unspecified and returning here remains a tentative suggestion. A meeting here is suggested; participants remain implicit.
rationale: 我也无话可说 is singular first-person inability to add a response, not a plural promise to stop persuading. The proposed correction fixes that. I additionally restore the explicit tentative meeting (见面怎么样), which merely coming back leaves implicit; all unspecified collection objects remain unspecified. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The player caught the Pokémon; merely seeing it is insufficient. The wall resemblance supports a tentative inference of more kinds in the ruins. Do not assert where the player caught it.
rationale: 抓到 means caught rather than merely saw. 在遗迹里 belongs to the inferred remaining varieties, not the capture location; 应该 is a qualified inference. The proposal repairs all three while keeping resemblance and uncertainty. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Rotation is tied to touching corners, with no duration requirement. Holding and moving relocates a fragment. The ancient Pokémon panels were excavated from the ruins. Four corners remain explicit; no claim of one particular corner, simultaneous touches or measured hitbox is added.
rationale: 出土 supplies excavation provenance; 四个边角 supplies four corners, not a short touch duration; 按住 requires holding while moving. I revise the proposal to say touch at the four corners, avoiding added any/all/simultaneous input instructions, restore the ruins-hut greeting, and explicitly retain the press-and-hold action. Ownership of the four corners and hitboxes remain unverified. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Marauder sees an exhausted foe as an opportunity to kill them. The anticipated gain is great credit or merit, not a promised rank promotion.
rationale: 立大功 is a great meritorious achievement, not a guaranteed promotion. The proposal correctly removes promotion, but earn some major credit sounds bureaucratic in this murderous boast. Cover myself in glory is an idiomatic boast of great distinction without a concrete rank, cash or award promise. The explicit killing threat remains. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The regret concerns living alone, not a confession of selfishness. The speaker intends to connect sincerely with Pokémon again.
rationale: 一个人生活 is solitary living and not selfishness. 交心 with 再次 is renewed sincere connection. The proposed English expresses both, retains the self-reproach, and does not invent a reason for solitude. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The Factory uses rental Pokémon and demands Pokémon knowledge. The speaker assesses having no chance elsewhere; success here remains only possible.
rationale: The source explicitly requires Pokémon knowledge and contrasts 完全没有胜算 elsewhere with 或许能行 here. I replace know your Pokémon with know a lot about Pokémon to avoid suggesting knowledge of personally owned rentals, and replace may not stand a chance with do not stand a chance to preserve the categorical self-assessment. Success here stays tentative. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Serena cannot go on stage with Pokémon herself. She promises wholehearted support and hopes to help the addressee. No reason is supplied for her inability to participate.
rationale: 和精灵一起登上舞台 identifies Pokémon as the stage companions. There is no claim about the player trying hard. I retain the corrected companionship and remove that addition, while rendering 尽全力支持 as support with everything I have got; support is broader than cheering and fits her earnest promise. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Green and Silver are addressed; Lance, Pryce and others are at the exit. The proposal is to open the exit first and let those allies in.
rationale: The opening 小蓝、小银 is direct address; the following additional allies are outside. The punctuation-only correction distinguishes those roles while preserving Mr. Lance, Pryce, the exit and the plan to let them in first. The matching unselected #26 needs separate review. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The Orb is a token for going to another world to summon a legendary Pokémon. The League returned it, and taking it remains permitted if needed. Do not add Giratina’s name to this line.
rationale: 去另一个世界召唤 is going to the other world to summon, reinforced by #20. Summoning from another world changes that relation. The proposal changes only that clause, retaining returned Orb, overturned belief, heroic deeds, tentative worthiness and conditional permission. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: This line describes the radio as ominous without asserting why. Malfunction information from #21 is not imported here.
rationale: 不祥 directly characterizes the radio as ominous. It says neither broken nor sinister broadcast. The proposal restores precisely that quality; #21’s switch state does not replace this sentence. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Ownership does not waive admission. Fees support livelihood; new equipment research is also needed to aid Pokédex completion. Do not invent that the player is upset. The farewell invites unhurried enjoyment.
rationale: The original omits livelihood and research expenditure, and adds reassurance against upset. The proposal restores the reasons and plural we. I additionally preserve 慢慢 in the farewell as take your time; ownership, admission and Pokédex purpose remain unchanged. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The player’s gender is unspecified. Giovanni needs time for summoning; the subordinate must delay this person.
rationale: The referent is the arriving player in #15–16. D-1224 specifically requires gender-neutral English for source 他 in that situation. The minimal he-to-they correction preserves arrival uncertainty, summoning and the order to delay. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Meowth demands kowtowing as well as an apology/admission. The threat and meow-style voice remain.
rationale: 磕头 requires bodily submission beyond kneeling alone, and 认错 demands admission/apology. Kowtow is semantically correct, but can be read figuratively and is stiff in the established colloquial Meowth voice. The revised concrete kneel-and-bow wording preserves the humiliating act and the existing ya/meow voice. No verified dub quotation is claimed. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The call timing is Tuesday night. Morty explicitly offers another battle at that time.
rationale: 再和你比试 explicitly offers another battle at the Tuesday-night call window. Free and ready omitted the purpose. The proposal preserves timing and request while restoring the rematch without inventing an exact hour. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The romantic analogy concerns loss of attack power, not inability or unwillingness to choose an attack. The question remains rhetorical; add no stages, percentages or guarantee. Learning Charm costs one Nugget.
rationale: 攻击力 denotes attacking power, not willingness. 瞬间 makes the effect immediate in the rhetorical illustration. The proposal restores those meanings while retaining the romance/Charm pun, one-Nugget fee and invitation. It adds no stat stages or tested gameplay guarantee. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The radio plays Pokémon Lullaby and makes wild Pokémon sleepy. The advice is to walk without anxiety, with no numerical encounter rate or zero-encounter guarantee.
rationale: The named lullaby makes Pokémon feel sleepy; the consequence stated is reassurance about walking through grass, not a quantified encounter rate. The proposal preserves the title and that advice, with no lyrics or assertion that all encounters cease. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Fuji explicitly frames both children as his own from his perspective. The command demands obedience and entering a Poké Ball without gendering Mewtwo. This new sentence is not labeled an official English film quote.
rationale: 乖乖听话 is patronizing obedience, without boy or another gender noun. The proposed correction removes the unsupported gender. I also retain 对我来说 explicitly as To me: the relationship is Fuji’s claim and perspective, not an external fact. The scene’s paternal manipulation remains strong. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Abra defeated the speaker’s Fighting-type rapidly/easily. No exact move or hit count is stated. Damn it retains the established frustrated tone.
rationale: 三两下 denotes quick/easy dispatch rather than exactly two attacks. In no time restores that idiom while preserving the frustrated exclamation, Fighting type and Abra as agent. No death or precise turn count is asserted. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The player urgently needs to reach Fuchsia City. Delay entails consequences the blocker cannot answer for, without specifying personal revenge. The command to move aside remains forceful.
rationale: 付不起责任 warns of responsibility/consequences that cannot be borne; the old you will pay for it suggests direct retaliation. The proposal recognizes the distinction, but cannot answer for the consequences is cumbersome dialogue. You cannot afford the consequences keeps the warning natural and does not specify punishment or the urgent business. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The deception has failed. Taking by force is contemplated as the only remaining option; what is taken stays unspecified.
rationale: 忽悠不住 is failed deception; 用抢的 is seizure by force as the remaining method. The proposal restores force, but its declarative guess with a question mark is awkward. Do I have to take it by force, then? preserves the reluctant rhetorical question and necessity without naming the property. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: The contrast is a pure illusion versus using a living person as medium. The claim remains a question; no technology, possession mechanism or host identity is added.
rationale: 用活人做媒介 gives a living person a mediating role, not merely real-person identity. The proposal restores that role and preserves the this-time questioning contrast. No controller, host identity or possession mechanism is invented. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

en: Venusaur risked its life protecting Green, who suffered only minor injuries. Team Rocket’s legendary power made Green younger/smaller; no exact age is added. Her figure complaint and uncertainty about changing back remain.
rationale: 拼死 explicitly conveys mortal stakes; the attempted killing and severe Venusaur injury in the context support risked its life. The proposal preserves the distinction between risk and death, and keeps the minor injury, youth/figure joke and uncertain restoration intact. The parallel #75 is outside this selection. Independently LLM-reviewed; not human-approved.

title: Text speed: fix the FAST margin edge and make timing gates phase-independent
en: Approved 2026-10-08: (B) native fix for the FAST frame-drop edge (the 1-line MARGIN does not cover sub-line rounding plus pass_end; raise the margin or round the remaining-lines estimate up), and (A) redesign the timing gates so they hold at both input phases: run timing scenarios at 0- and 1-frame input delay (both must pass), measure callbacks latency phase-independently (printer passes or the observed prompt poll instead of fixed frames with PROMPT_READY=2), replace the exact field-rate idle-pass equality with a phase-independent check. Then full suite and fault matrix.
rationale: User decision after the develop gate run: three failures came from bank 0435's ROM offset shifting the game one frame out of phase with the fixed input script; the RC has the same latent behaviours and passed by luck of phase.
