Pure character typos in 0627 (same text as 0393, see D-2084): #26/#48 中年年子 for 中年男子; #78 好想 for 好像; #123 狠厉害 for 很厉害. English already reads the intended word; nothing to change.
rationale: AGENTS.md: pure typos are translated as intended and still logged

en: Elm's line reads '{player}说很想看看从蛋里孵出的精灵', i.e. the player says they want to see the hatched Pokémon; vanilla has Elm himself asking to see it. Likely a hack/translation slip. Now translated literally: '{player} says they’d love to see the Pokémon that hatched from that Egg!'. Proposed corrected line if approved (D-1496): 'I’d love to see the Pokémon that hatched from that Egg, {player}.' (unused strings: no script path)

Full-party refusal says 整理一下背包 (sort out your Bag) although the problem is a full party. Now translated literally: 'You’re carrying too many Pokémon. Sort out your Bag and come back.' Proposed corrected line if approved (D-1496): '...Sort out your party and come back.'
Character typo: 让妈妈挺大你健康的声音 should be 听到 (hear). Translated as intended (unchanged US-style line: 'Call your mom on your Pokégear to let her know how you’re doing.').

Status 'reviewed', so not edited in RV053. zh 要想收集不同的精灵就要到不同的地方寻找 = 'to collect different Pokémon, look in different places'; current 'If you want to catch them all, you have to look everywhere.' changes the meaning. Proposed: 'The Pokémon up ahead are a little different from those on Route 29. If you want to collect different Pokémon, you have to look for them in different places!'

Status 'reviewed', so not edited in RV053 (see also D-1835). Rule 4 在战斗中精灵持有的回复物品也要收回 says nothing about Pokémon recovering; rule 6 相对的赢的人可以得到战斗点数 drops 'the winner'. Proposed: '4. Healing items your Pokémon hold in battle will also be recovered!' and '6. In exchange, the winner earns Battle Points!'

Pure character typos in the zh, translated as the intended words: 0538#79 飘荡额柔软 (额 for 而, 'soft and flowing'); 0538#34/#51/#52/#69/#77 永远永们远 (garbled 我们永远, 'we'll be together forever'). English needs no change.

Yellow (小黄) addresses the player as {player}哥哥/姐姐 (gender branches) throughout the hack, but the English drops the 'Big Bro'/'Big Sis' everywhere. Other reviewers restored the same address for Silver (D-2099) and kids on Route 1. Restore it for Yellow game-wide, or keep dropping it? (raised by RV016, RV054, RV055)

Bag message says you can't GET Mail here (获得); the JP original is ここで メールを かくことは できません (can't WRITE Mail here). English now follows the zh: "You can't get Mail here!". Proposed fix: "You can't write Mail here!" (the former US line).

PC box item message says 'No {item}!' (没有); the JP original is {item}を もてない！ (can't hold it). English now follows the zh: "No {VAR:0108:0}!". Proposed fix: "Cannot hold {VAR:0108:0}!" (the former US line).
Character typo: doubled 了 (了了) in 'has no will to fight left'. No effect on the English ('{VAR:0101:0} has no energy left to battle!').
Hack typo: 穿洞绳 is duplicated (你在这用穿洞绳穿洞绳). Translated once as intended ('You’re using an Escape Rope here?'); no other meaning.

title: Blackout text: the loser and the Youngster are swapped in the Chinese
en: The Chinese ({VAR:0103:2}在和短裤小子的战斗中失败了, same in the vanilla Chinese HGSS) makes buffer 2 the one who lost against 'the Youngster'; the JP original says 'Lost the battle against Youngster {VAR:0103:2}' (たんぱんこぞうの {VAR:0103:2} との しょうぶに まけた), i.e. buffer 2 is the opponent. English now follows the Chinese. Proposed corrected line (needs user approval, D-1496): 'Lost the battle against{NEWLINE}Youngster {VAR:0103:2}...'
rationale: Translation slip inherited from the vanilla Chinese; JP proves the intended meaning

title: Mulch descriptions 471/472: both say the soil dries more slowly
en: In the Chinese (same as vanilla Chinese HGSS) #471 says 'soil dries more slowly, Berries grow more slowly' and #472 'soil dries more slowly, Berries take longer to ripen'. JP/US #471 is Stable Mulch's effect (ripe Berries stay on the plant longer: きのみが おちるまでの じかんが ながくなる) and #472 Damp Mulch's (dries slower, grows slower). So the Chinese #471 no longer describes Stable Mulch and no line describes it. English follows the Chinese. Proposed fix (needs user approval, D-1496): #471 'It extends the time ripened Berries{NEWLINE}remain on their plants before falling.' (US/JP)
rationale: Inherited translation error; JP/US show the intended texts

zh: 精灵跟在身后走的时候 无法使用！
en: Field-move block message: the Chinese says it cannot be used "while a Pokémon is following you", but in HGSS (a Pokémon always follows) the US line at this slot is for walking with an NPC partner: "You can’t use that when you have someone with you." Likely a mistranslation in the hack/its Chinese base. English now follows the Chinese; proposed corrected line (needs user approval, D-1496): "You can’t use that when you have someone with you."

title: Vanilla US lines: keep unless the meaning differs
en: For text the hack did not change (vanilla battle/system/menu/description lines whose Chinese is the official translation), keep the official US English when it says the same thing as the Chinese, even in different words. Fix it only where the meaning differs, or where it drops or adds content compared with the Chinese. Lines the hack rewrote are always translated from the Chinese.
rationale: User 2026-10-08 (re-review): answers D-1621; amends D-1378 so real meaning differences, drops and additions are fixed.

en: D-0918 keeps US 'concerned about' for zh 很好奇/很有兴趣 (curious/interested), but in English 'concerned' reads as 'worried', which changes the meaning; #214 also adds 'going' (zh 好奇外面 = curious about outside). Proposed: #131 'is curious about the trap.', #214 'is curious about outside!', #221 'seems very interested in the waterfall!', #346 'seems curious about the swaying pillar.' Left unchanged in RV067 because D-0918 explicitly keeps the wording.
Character typo in the hack's zh: 坐在穿上很开心 has 穿 for 船 (boat). English already reads 'enjoying the boat ride!' (intended word); no change needed.

zh: 你以为 你已经赢了马？
en: Pure character typo in the Chinese: 赢了马 for 赢了吗 (question particle). Translated as the intended question: "Do you think you’ve won already?" No change needed.
rationale: Pure character typo, logged per AGENTS.md

zh: 你还不能适应与忍者作战, 回去想想战术再来吧。
en: Trainer 258 (Leader Sabrina) turning-point line talks about fighting a ninja (a Koga line); her rematch #292 has a Sabrina-style line instead. Kept as the Chinese says: "You are not yet used to fighting a ninja. Go back, rethink your tactics and come again." Possible fix if approved: use the rematch line "I have already seen what happens next."
rationale: Speaker/line mismatch in the hack; translated faithfully (D-1496 needs user approval)

title: Summary characteristics: hack Chinese departs from the JP/US characteristic meanings
en: Several Characteristic strings in the summary memo differ in meaning from the Japanese/US originals they translate: #79 容易受伤 'gets hurt easily' (JP けんかを するのが すき / US 'Likes to fight'), #81 喜欢用身体力量决胜负 (JP からだが じょうぶ / US 'Sturdy body'), #93 小心谨慎 (JP ぬけめが ない / US 'Thoroughly cunning'), #96 暴躁 (JP きが つよい / US 'Strong willed'), #100 有些坚强 (US 'Somewhat stubborn'); smaller drifts at #78, #86, #88, #89, #95, #98. RV060 now follows the Chinese (D-2201). If the user wants the stat-linked official meanings back, proposed English = the US lines quoted above.
rationale: #79 reverses the official meaning; English now follows the hack's Chinese

title: Trainer memo: Chinese drops the traded 'apparently' variants and merges Egg origins
en: In the hack's Chinese the vanilla trade variants of the trainer memo lose their 似乎 (apparently): #57 = #56, #59 = #58, #63 = #62 word for word, and #53/#55 have no 似乎; #61 says 得到 (obtained) where vanilla says arrived; #101/#102/#104 are all 从…那里拿到 (received from), and #103/#104 lack the vanilla 'very mysterious'. The English previously restored these distinctions silently; RV060 made it follow the Chinese. Proposed corrected English if approved: #53/#55/#59/#63 'Egg apparently hatched.', #57 'Apparently had a fateful encounter at Lv. N.', #61 'Egg arrived.' + 'Egg apparently hatched.', #102 'obtained in', #103/#104 'A very mysterious Pokémon Egg obtained at / that came from'.
rationale: Previous English silently restored vanilla distinctions the Chinese does not make

title: 0295#73 typo 打磕睡 for 打瞌睡
en: 0295#73 经常打磕睡 uses 磕 for 瞌 (打瞌睡 = doze off). Pure character typo; English 'Nods off a lot.' already gives the intended meaning.
rationale: Pure character typo in the Chinese, logged per AGENTS.md

title: 0295#127 满腹度 (fullness) shown as SHEEN
en: 0295#127 Chinese 满腹度 = fullness (the hack/Chinese base renamed the vanilla sheen stat); English keeps the official label SHEEN. Under D-2201 the meaning differs. Proposed: keep SHEEN (official term for the same mechanic), or FULLNESS if the condition-page label box fits 8 capitals. Needs a user call and an in-game width check.
rationale: Label meaning differs from the Chinese but names the same official mechanic

en: Character typo in the hack's zh: 似乎意味 has 意味 for 以为 (thinks that). English already reads 'seems to think that {VAR:0103:2} has disappeared!' (intended word); no change needed.
Character typo in the hack's zh: 波上水 has 波 for 泼 (splashed), as in #594 泼上了水. English translates the intended word: '{VAR:0101:0} seems very happy to be splashed!'
Character typo in the hack's zh: 挑起了健壮的舞蹈 has 挑 for 跳 (dance), as in #560/#566 跳起了健壮的舞. English already reads '{VAR:0101:0} did a vigorous dance!' (intended word); no change needed.

zh 盯着水面都没有的地方看 ('staring at a place where there is not even a water surface') looks like a garble of 盯着什么都没有的地方看 ('staring at nothing at all', cf. #541). English keeps the US line '{VAR:0101:0} is staring patiently at nothing at all.' Check whether 水面 is intended (e.g. used near water); if so, propose 'is staring at a spot with no water at all...'.

Same issue as D-2202 in part 2: US 'concerned about' for zh 很感兴趣/很好奇/非常有兴趣 (interested/curious) reads as 'worried' in English. Left unchanged in RV068 because D-0918 keeps the wording. Proposed: #414 'seems very interested in your mom!', #506 'seems curious about the other side of the fence.', #511 'Your Pokémon seems very interested in the room below.', #733 'seems curious about what is inside the case.' (#730 was retranslated in RV068 for other reasons: 'seems curious about the spinning machine.')

zh 向{VAR:0101:0}展示了自己的强大 has no subject: someone showed {VAR:0101:0} their own strength. The US line '{VAR:0101:0} took the opportunity to show off how strong it is!' makes the follower the actor. No script path in the scene cache to identify the actor, so RV068 left the US line. Proposed if the follower is not the actor: 'Showed {VAR:0101:0} how strong it is!' (actor unnamed, as in the zh).

title: 0718 #471-#781: pure character typos in trainer lines
en: Pure character typos in the Chinese, each translated as the intended word (no change needed): #471 我认可你得实力 (得 for 的); #610 要参去精灵联盟 (参去 for 参加, take part); #731 一边联系喷火 (联系 for 练习, practise); #742 皮皮和月之石之前的关系 (之前 for 之间, between); #754 没法再教科书上学到 (再 for 在); #781 我觉不允许 (觉 for 绝, absolutely not).
rationale: Logged per AGENTS.md typo rule; English already reads as the intended word

en: Typo: 作为人生精英 (life elite) reads as 人生经验 (life experience); translated as the intended word: 'A Ribbon for recalling a failure that became experience for life.'
rationale: pure character typo, translated intended word

en: Typo: 颜色不用的精灵 should be 颜色不同 (differently coloured); English 'a Pokémon with unusual coloring' follows the intended word.
rationale: pure character typo, translated intended word

en: Ribbon texts: RV061 followed the Chinese, 'Christmas Ribbon' (圣诞节纪念缎带) instead of the official US 'Evergreen Ribbon', and 'Pokémon Center New York' instead of 'Nintendo World NY'. Keep the literal Chinese, or restore the official US ribbon names?

title: 0718 #1066-#1145: pure character typos in trainer lines
en: Pure character typos in the Chinese, each translated as the intended word (no change needed): #1066 技能及其 for 技能机器 (TMs); #1072 你不害吗 for 你不害怕吗 (missing 怕, 'Aren't you scared?'); #1108 我们再卡吉镇的基地 (再 for 在); #1145 那都说编出来的故事 (second 说 for 是).
rationale: Logged per AGENTS.md typo rule; English already reads as the intended word

en: Unused Sinnoh Town Map text for Twinleaf Town calls it 小路 'little path'; the place is a town (JP/US: small town), so 小路 is likely a slip for 小镇. English now follows the Chinese: 'A little path where you can feel…'. Proposed fix if approved: 'A little town where you can feel the breath of fresh leaves and the start of something new.'
rationale: Silent path→town correction undone per D-1496/D-1500; logged for user approval.

en: Unused Sinnoh Town Map text for Iron Island says it lies off 白岱市 (this text's name for Eterna City, cf. 白岱森林 = Eterna Forest in #10); Iron Island is off Canalave City. English follows the Chinese: 'A small mining island off the coast of Eterna City.' Proposed fix if approved: '…off the coast of Canalave City.'
rationale: Place name restored as the Chinese says; suspected source error logged.

en: Footstep House man's personal name 卷太 was dropped; RV062 restored it as pinyin 'Juantai' (low confidence). The official JP/US name, if any, is unverified. Confirm or supply a romanisation: 'A man named Juantai, known as Dr. Footstep, lives alone in a hut by the shore.'
rationale: Name needed to avoid omission; romanisation unverified.

en: Pure character typos in the Chinese, translated as the intended word: 0236#53 今天的最后一天 (今天 for 今年: 'last day of the year', every following line is about the year/New Year); 0237#13 你在说写什么 (写 for 些); 0237#22 不亏是 (亏 for 愧); 0237#25 我总回走到 (回 for 会); 0239#34 抓带的 (带 for 到, cf. parallel #31 抓到了). English already says the intended word in each case; no other reading.
rationale: Typo log required by AGENTS.md pure-typo rule (RV069 re-review).

en: Day-Care Lady's phone readout: zh 等级已经到{VAR:0134:N}了 says the Pokémon's level has reached N, while vanilla US says it has grown by about N levels (the value may be the level gain). English now follows the zh ('Your X has reached Level N.'). If the variable is the gain, proposed fix: 'By level, your X has grown by about N.'

Partner phone tip: zh says the town itself (那个小镇) is called 灵魂之家 (House of Memories), which is a building in Lavender Town (#137 says so correctly). English now follows the zh. Proposed fix: 'In that town, there’s a place called the House of Memories, where there are Pokémon graves.'

Partner phone tips: #20 says take Psychic-type moves (超能系的技能) to Mr. Psychic (#93 says Psychic Pokémon); #65 says a Bayleef is at the Fan Club (那儿还有月桂叶), where #138 tells you to bring your own Chikorita. Likely source mistranslations; English now follows the zh. Proposed fixes: #20 'I wonder what would happen if you took Psychic-type Pokémon there?', #65 'If you’ve got a Bayleef, take it there and say hi!'
Typo: 是马 for 是吗 ('I see...'). English translates the intended word.
Typo: 米那君君 (doubled 君) for 米那君 (Eusine). English says Eusine.
Typo: 厉害的关注 for 厉害的馆主 (strong Gym Leaders). English translates the intended word.
Typo: 许多么见过的精灵 for 许多没见过的精灵 (Pokémon you’ve never seen). English translates the intended word.
Typo: 撒乱 for 骚乱 (commotion). English translates the intended word.

title: Phone-bank character typos (RV072)
en: Pure character typos in the hack's phone text, translated as the intended word: 0662#5 爱？ for 哎？ ('Huh?'); 0667#3 是妈 for 是吗 ('All right...'); 0669#9 没礼拜 for 没礼貌 ('rude'); 0671#21 堡电话粥 for 煲电话粥 ('long phone chats'); 0675#14 赶紧把 for 赶紧吧; 0677#2 会再你联络 for 会和你联络; 0676#3 and #16 duplicated 博士博士 (rendered 'Professor Oak'). No English change needed.
rationale: Log pure typos per AGENTS.md; English already uses the intended words

en: Pokégear map text for the south end of Cycling Road (Route 18) says 北侧的终点 "northern end point" although #85 (Route 16) is already the northern starting point; US says southern. English now follows the zh ("The northern end point of Cycling Road."). Proposed fix if approved: "The southern end point{NEWLINE}of Cycling Road."

Pokégear map descriptions of Johto routes call them towns (镇/城镇): #98 Route 29 "旅行之镇", #99 Route 30, #103 Route 34, #109 Route 40; #41 says 小镇 and 无关传说 "regardless of legends" where the US/JP sense is a path sunset-colored regardless of season. English now follows the zh. Proposed fixes if approved: #98 "A quiet road for travelers,{NEWLINE}wrapped in the scent of grass."; #99 "A spirited road where young{NEWLINE}Trainers go looking for a challenge."; #103 "A road with lots of greenery,{NEWLINE}even though it’s next to a big city."; #109 "A sea-breeze road where the sea{NEWLINE}stretches out west of Olivine City."; #41 "A path whose leaves are dyed the color{NEWLINE}of sunset, whatever the season."

Pokémon Music: the zh names the Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun show 精灵比赛 "Pokémon Match/competition" where the game plays the Pokémon March (JP マーチ; US "march"), likely a mistranslation. English now says "Pokémon Match time" per the zh. Proposed fix if approved: "Today’s Monday!{NEWLINE}It’s Pokémon March time, when Pokémon{NEWLINE}are full of pep!" (same for Wed/Fri/Sun). Also #11 北方大路 is a typo for 北方大陆 "great land to the north"; translated as the intended word.
Trainer Profiles #4 ends 这样的补充ｚ, a character typo for 捕虫(少年) Bug Catcher; English keeps "this Bug Catcher!" (intended word).
Character typo: 训练是 should be 训练师 (Trainer). English already says 'tough Trainers'; no change needed.
Character typo: 药 (medicine) should be 要 ('even stronger than I imagined'). English already translates the intended word.

zh: 如果大树能在更年轻的时候
en: Character typo: 大树 (big tree) should be 大叔 (Parry's self-reference). English ('If only I'd begun training Pokémon when I was a tad younger') translates the intended word.

zh: 你已经好就没和我进行精灵对战了
en: Character typo: 好就 should be 好久 ('it's been ages'). English translates the intended word.
Character typo: 金钾市 (钾 = potassium) should be 金岬市 (Snowpoint City), as in 0723#19. English already says Snowpoint City.
Tuscany's line names her brother 水男 instead of 水雄 (Wesley); pure character typo of the sibling name. English keeps 'Wesley' (intended name), no edit needed.
rationale: Pure name typo; translated as intended per AGENTS.md

zh: 让自己的身形变轻后及逆行高速运动
en: Agility description: 及逆行 looks like a character typo for 进行 ('lightens its body, then moves at high speed'). Translated the intended word: 'The user lightens its body to move at high speed. Raises its Speed by 2 stages.'
rationale: Pure character typo; no other plausible reading.

en: Aromatherapy description: 泌人心扉 looks like a character typo for the idiom 沁人心扉 ('refreshing to the heart'). English 'soothing scent' already reflects the intended word; no change.
rationale: Pure character typo; idiom is 沁人心扉.

en: Character typo: BlackGlasses (#240 外形奇特的眼睛) and Wise Glasses (#267 带厚镜片的眼睛) write 眼睛 'eyes' for 眼镜 'glasses'. Pure typo; English already says glasses (kept: 'Shady-looking glasses…', 'a thick pair of glasses…').
rationale: Pure character typo translated as the intended word, logged per AGENTS.md.

title: Character typos in RV084 banks (Frontier trainer text, move tutor)
en: Pure character typos, translated as the intended word: 0714#668 下才 for 下次 (next time); 0714#780 线上礼物 for 献上礼物 (present a gift); 0714#848 创走 for 创造 (building); 0104#22 你的的 doubled 的. No English change needed.

zh: 效果一般的时候技能威力上升。
en: Tinted Lens description says 效果一般 (power rises when effectiveness is 'normal'); the game's own battle text uses 效果一般 for 'It's normally effective' (a027/0296#3) and 效果不好 for 'not very effective'. Probably meant 效果不好 (vanilla Tinted Lens). English kept as US 'Powers up “not very effective” moves.' (colloquial 一般 = so-so). If literal is wanted: 'Powers up normally effective moves.'
rationale: Possible hack wording error; RV090 kept US reading pending user.

zh: 异常状态中攻击速度上升。
en: Quick Feet: 攻击速度 has no separator, so it may mean 'Speed' (attack speed, vanilla Quick Feet) or 'Attack and Speed'. English says 'Ups Attack and Speed with a status problem.' Check the hack's actual effect; if only Speed: 'Boosts Speed if there is a status problem.'
rationale: Ambiguous zh; behaviour not verifiable from text.

en: 0791#335 (Zangoose): zh 好以来 is a character typo (missing 久: 好久以来 'for a long time'). English 'It has been battling Seviper for ages' already renders the intended word; no change needed.

Punctuation typo: the zh of a027/0003#733 and #734 (wild / foe 'used Psych Up' lines) lacks the closing ！ that #732 and every other 'used <move>' line has. English keeps the US 'The wild/The foe's {VAR:0101:0} used Psych Up!' with the '!'; no change proposed.

a027/0003#1134-1136 (move #378) use the old zh name 绑紧 for Wring Out (0739 #378 = 绞紧; 绑紧 is Bind #20 in 0739). The English 'Wring Out' is correct per D-0012 (English follows the move id), but QA warns 'glossary 绑紧 → Bind'. Proposal: add qa_ignore ['glossary:绑紧'] to these three strings, as D-0012 prescribes for the other old names; reviewers may not touch that field.

a027/0195#148/149: the Chinese says the side-effect move "attack had no effect" (攻击无效), while the US line at this slot is "The effect of your team’s/the foe’s <move> wore off!" (the same slot as the Japanese 効果が切れた). Likely a mistranslation in the Chinese source. RV097 translated the Chinese ("The attack of your team’s <move> had no effect!"). Proposed fix if approved (D-1496): restore the US lines "The effect of your team’s{NEWLINE}<move> wore off!" / "The effect of the foe’s{NEWLINE}<move> wore off!".
rationale: Literal Chinese contradicts the message slot; needs user approval to correct.

en: a027/0195: the Chinese drops mechanic detail the US slot carries. #79-81 (Toxic slot) say only 中毒了 "was poisoned" (same as #63-65), not badly poisoned (cf. battle_string 1#324 中剧毒了); #208-210 (Rest slot) say only 开始睡觉了 "started sleeping", not "slept and became healthy" (cf. battle_string 1#860 睡着了，并且变得精力充沛). RV097 translated the Chinese (D-2201). Proposed fix if approved (D-1496): restore US "was badly poisoned!" / "slept and became healthy!".
rationale: English now follows the less specific Chinese; restoring the mechanic wording needs user approval.

en: a027/0195#351: pure character typo in the Chinese, 但是的 for 但是, (cf. #352/#353 但是,野生的/对手的). English "{VAR:0101:0} already has a substitute!" is unaffected; no change needed.
rationale: Typo logged per AGENTS.md; translation unaffected.

en: 0791#925 (Maushold): zh 仍是个迷 is a character typo for 仍是个谜 (still a mystery; 迷 for 谜). English already reads 'is a mystery'; no text change needed.
Character typos in the Chinese: 0483#62 下了一跳 for 吓了一跳 (got a scare); 0483#23 doubles 不要不要. English already translates the intended words. (Split from D-2129, whose 游唦 item was not a typo.)

a027/0195: the Chinese at these vanilla slots says something other than the US line, and RV099 translated the Chinese (D-2201). #987 (recall after taking some damage) 很好！回来吧 'very good! Come back!' vs US 'enough! Get back!'; #1168-1170 (Toxic Orb slot) 因为<item>中毒了 'was poisoned by the <item>' vs US 'was badly poisoned' (cf. D-2254); #1235-1237 <X>没能使出技能 '<X> failed to use its move' where the buffer is the move's target, vs US 'It failed to affect <X>!' (role reversed, suspected Chinese source mistranslation). Proposed fix if approved (D-1496): restore the US lines '<X>, enough!{NEWLINE}Get back!', '<X> was badly{NEWLINE}poisoned by the <item>!', 'It failed to affect{NEWLINE}<X>!' (with the wild/foe variants).
rationale: Chinese differs from the slot's US meaning; restoring the US wording needs user approval.

en: a027/0195#1042-1044 (Rapid Spin slot): the Chinese reads '<X> was blown away by <move>' (被), which reverses the roles and makes no sense for the effect; almost certainly a one-character slip for 把 ('<X> blew away <move>'). title: Wi-Fi Plaza countdown lines: Chinese says the time limit was 'set', not 'reached'
en: The hack's Chinese (vanilla Chinese UI, likely a mistranslation of the Japanese 'time limit reached') says 限制时间已确定 'the time limit has been set' (#18), 没有设定限制时间,人员没能集齐 'no time limit was set and not enough members gathered' (#19), 已经决定了限制时间,X中止 'the time limit has been decided, X canceled' (#21). Context (waiting-room countdown #15 'N seconds to go') shows the meaning is the countdown running out. RV121 restored the literal English (the old English silently repaired it). Proposed corrected English if approved under D-1496: #18 'The time limit has been reached.{NEWLINE}Let the game begin!'; #19 'Not enough members gathered within{NEWLINE}the time limit.{SCROLL}Please register from the start again.{SCROLL}'; #21 'The time limit has been reached.{NEWLINE}The {VAR:0300:0} has been canceled!{SCROLL}'.
rationale: Re-review RV121: silent correction undone per brief; user decides whether to fix.
